تنتقدون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِدُونَ (tantaqidūna) /tan.ta.qi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# تُنْتَقَدُونَ (tuntaqadūna) /tun.ta.qa.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
